name: Card Payment Transaction 117
definition: Transaction information in the cancellation response.

SaleReferenceIdentification.name: Sale Reference Identification
SaleReferenceIdentification.definition: Global reference of the sale transaction for the sale system.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the transaction assigned by the POI (Point Of Interaction).

InitiatorTransactionIdentification.name: Initiator Transaction Identification
InitiatorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the initiating party for the recipient party.

RecipientTransactionIdentification.name: Recipient Transaction Identification
RecipientTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the recipient party for the initiating party.

ReconciliationIdentification.name: Reconciliation Identification
ReconciliationIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the reconciliation period between the acceptor and the acquirer. This identification might be linked to the identification of the settlement for further verification by the merchant.

InterchangeData.name: Interchange Data
InterchangeData.definition: Interchange information related to the card scheme.
